liste.en: Men are like the oxen: they lie down together, but don’t get up together.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0523

liste.mg: Vy olombelona hoatra ny ladim-boatavo, ka raha Sotorana, tray hiany.
liste.en: Men are like the creeping stem of the pumpkin, and if traced, are found to be one.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0532

liste.mg: My olombelona toy ny akondro : raha manondro ny lanttra, tray hiany ; fa raha miondrtka, samy manana ny lafiny.
liste.en: Men are like banana trees: when they point to the sky (i.e. the leaves), they are one; but when they bend down, each has its own place.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0533

liste.mg: Tsthy be lambana ny ambantlanttra.
liste.en: Men are a large mat.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0535

liste.mg: Aza ny lohasaha mangingina no heverina, fa Andriamanitra no ambontn’ ny loha.
liste.en: Don’t think of the silent valley, for it is God who is overhead.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0540

liste.mg: Tsy misy tsy fantatr’ Andriamanitra, saingy minta miondrtka Izy.
liste.en: There is nothing unknown to God, but He determines to bend down (as if to see).
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0541

liste.mg: Andriamanttra tsy an’ ny irery.
liste.en: God does not belong to one (alone).
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0546

liste.mg: Andriamanitra tsy andrin’ ny olona andriko hiany.
liste.en: God who is not waited for by others is waited for by me.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0552

liste.mg: Toy ny akoho kely misotro rano, ka ny Andriamanitra no andrandrainy.
liste.en: Like the chicken drinking water, it lifts its head to God alone.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0555

liste.mg: Na dia manarona akoho aza, raka mby amin’ ny omen’ Andriamanttra, dia manana.
liste.en: Even as to the covering over of the fowls, if God wills it, you will prosper.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0558

liste.mg: Aza mandidy alohan’ Andriamanitra toy ny mpanotrika akoho.
liste.en: Don’t reckon your chickens before they are hatched.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0560

liste.mg: Aza manao vava azon’ Andrtamanttra.
liste.en: Don’t make out that what you say is heard by God.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0562

liste.mg: Aza mandtka ny soan-Fanahary.
liste.en: Don’t change the good things of God.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0563

liste.mg: Tarehy ratsy nataon-Fanahary, ka tsy vanon-kisarondoha.
liste.en: When God has made a face plain, covering the head won’t make it handsome.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0564

liste.mg: Fatra-piahiahy mamosavy ; fatra-pifehy trano fangalarina.
liste.en: Too suspicious proves you a witch; too careful to fasten up the house proves you a thief.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0571

liste.mg: Lamba mena nenti-nanttsaka, ka babon’ ny mptsambotra.
liste.en: A red robe taken to dance (on tombs) with and taken away by the one that catches (the wearer).
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0572

liste.mg: Aza faly am-panaovan-dratsy hoatra mpamosavy.
liste.en: Don't rejoice in doing evil like a witch.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0575

liste.mg: Tsy tia maro toa mpamosavy.
liste.en: To dislike many like a witch.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0576

liste.mg: Aza mandrara homana, toa fody.
liste.en: Bone forbid another to eat, like the weaver-finch.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0582

liste.mg: Mpamosavy natakalo omby mahery: lasa ny loza, fa tonga ny antambo.
liste.en: A witch exchanged for a wild ox: one evil has gone, but another has come.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0585

liste.mg: Raha mpamosavy azo nanttsaka, ataovy toy ny anana, ka raha mantry, tsongoy.
liste.en: If she is a witch caught treading (on the tombs), serve her as you do herbs,—pluck (them) up when they grow.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0587

liste.mg: Ramahaimanana no voatora-trano, ka Raintkotoamboa no lava hoho. :
liste.en: One has his house pelted at, so the other has long nails.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0589

liste.mg: Fantatro fa tohon-gavatra, fa intako jonoin-kankarary.
liste.en: I know that it is a spirit’s ¢oho, but I will angle for it, though it makes me ill.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0592

liste.mg: Miteny trery toy ny miresaka amim-bazimba.
liste.en: To speak to oneself, like him who talks to a Vazimba.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0593

liste.mg: Miangatra hianao ; taolan-doha hivolana va ?
liste.en: You are mocking ; shall a skull speak ?
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0594

liste.mg: Ny Vazimba no mankarary, ka ny akoho no mihanton-doha.
liste.en: It is the Vazimba that makes ill, so the fowl has its head hung up.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0595

liste.mg: Harem-bery foana, toy ny menaka ahoso-bazimba.
liste.en: Lost wealth, like the grease used to anoint the Vazimba, i.e. their tombs or sacred stones.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0598

liste.mg: Misakaiza amim-bazimba malahelo : ka ny akoholahy lany, ny fitahiana tsy misy.
liste.en: Making friends with a poor Vazimba: the cock is gone, and there is no blessing.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0599

liste.mg: Lolo mamoha angatra.
liste.en: A ghost that wakes a spirit.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0602

liste.mg: Ny papelika no maro vava, mitana ny hafatry ny ntaolo.
liste.en: The papeltka chatters much because it holds the will (messages or requests) of the ancients.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0604

liste.mg: Ny maty no tsy alevina Alakamisy sy Alahady, ny velona no tandrovina.
liste.en: The dead are not buried on Thursdays and Sundays because the living are cared for.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0605

liste.mg: Ny handrina no tsy mantry volo, ny henatra.
liste.en: No hair grows on the forehead because of shame.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0606

liste.mg: Boka mitoraka Alahamady, ka hitan’ Andriamanttra ny tarehiny.
liste.en: The leper throws in Alahamady, so God sees his face.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0610

liste.mg: Sendra mandalo Ramaka, ka may ny tanana.
liste.en: Mr. Fetch happens to pass, and the town gets on fire.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0613

liste.mg: Kaha ny tianao no hatao, hetstka Andriananahary ; fa raha ho an' olona, tangena ambontin’ ny varavarana.
liste.en: If what you wish is to be done, then God moves; but if for another, poison is over the door.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0615

liste.mg: Natao kitstkitsika hivavahana, kanjo voromahery hipaoka ny akoho.
liste.en: You were thought to be a Avfsikitstkha to pray to, but you are a voromahery which swoops down on the fowls.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0617

liste.mg: Tsy nisy nivavaka niankandrefana, fa samy nianavaratra hiany ; fa ny harena mila vintana, ka raha tsy. angara, tsy longa.
liste.en: No one prayed towards the west, but all prayed towards the north, yet wealth needs luck (or destiny), and if it isn’t your lot, it doesn’t come.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0618

liste.mg: Misorona ondry tsy volony, ka mankaloza ny aretina.
liste.en: To offer in sacrifice a bad sheep and intensify the disease.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0621

liste.mg: Toy ny atodin’ anganga : ka avela, mahafaty raibe ; entina, mahafaty renibe.
liste.en: Like the eggs of the anganga (a fabulous bird): left alone, they kill your grandfather; taken away, they kill your grandmother.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0624

liste.mg: Avoaroin’ ny vava ka sahalain’ ny vintana.
liste.en: Led astray by the mouth and judged by destiny.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0628

liste.mg: Tolo-kena maty giro, ka vintana no andrasana.
liste.en: A giving out of meat when the lamp has gone out: you wait for what falls to you (lit. your luck).
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0629

liste.mg: Fanafodin’ ny osa ny marina ataony.
liste.en: The medicine for the weak is his doing what is right.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0631

liste.mg: Ny hery tsy mahaleo ny fanahy.
liste.en: Strength does not equal goodness.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0635

liste.mg: Hianareo no natao valala fiandry fasana, vorompotsy tsy mandao omby.
liste.en: You were made a locust to watch the tomb, a white bird (little egret) not forsaking the oxen.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0638

liste.mg: Vy olona marina toy ny ombalahy ampandronjinana : tsy folaka ano, tsy maty mandrakizay.
liste.en: The upright are like contending bulls: neither conquered to-day, and never killed.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0641

liste.mg: Aza manao soa tapany.
liste.en: Don’t do good by halves.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0645

liste.mg: Manaova soa ampentany, fa misy hiankinana ; ary manaova soa vato, fa misy hipetrahana.
liste.en: Do good by means of a wall, for there is something to lean against ;
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0646

liste.mg: Tay ny fongo-bintsy an-ala, ka madio lavi-drano.
liste.en: Like the fect of the kingfisher in the forest, they are clean far from the water (when they may be expected to be dirty):
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0648

liste.mg: Ny ratsy fo tsy mba manan-kavana.
liste.en: The bad of heart have no friends.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0655

liste.mg: Aza ratsy alohan’ olona.
liste.en: Don't be the first to be bad.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0659

liste.mg: Aza mandthy am-piringa toa vorondolo.
liste.en: Don’t dance on a dunghill like an owl.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0666

liste.mg: Ny fandio tray siny tsy mahaleo ny fandoto tray tandroka.
liste.en: A pitcherful of clean water is not a match for a hornful of dirty water.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0670

liste.mg: Ny homana aza misy diso (na raraka) .
liste.en: There are faults even in eating.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0674

liste.mg: Maizina ny andro, azo tsilovina ; lalina ny rano, azo lakanina ; lalina ny hady, azo toharina ; fa ny ratsy atao tsy mba azon-kevitra.
liste.en: When the day is dark, it can be lighted up; when the water is deep, a canoe can be used ; when the fosse is deep, it can be reached by a ladder; but nothing can be done with an evil deed.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0675

liste.mg: Aza manafin-kilema momba tena.
liste.en: Don’t hide your own faults.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0678

liste.mg: Ny vilany nandrahoana no efa nipoaka.
liste.en: It’s the pot that boiled (the meat) that's burst.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0679

liste.mg: Raha monina anosy, lavitra olon-kiresahana.
liste.en: If you live on an island, you are far from people to talk with.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0682

liste.mg: Akondro noginjana hariva aho: ka raha tsy malazon' ny alina aza, mantsasaky ny alina.
liste.en: T’m a banana-tree cut down in the evening : if I’m not withered by night,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0683

liste.mg: Lambo soso-nify ka nentim-paharazana.
liste.en: A hog with a double tooth : it came from his ancestors,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0685

liste.mg: Manasa lamba be tseroka; na madio aza, mangarahara.
liste.en: Washing a very dirty dress; though it’s clean, it becomes full of holes.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0686

liste.mg: Ny akoho novonoina no mody latsa, ary ny atao no tonga adidy.
liste.en: The fowl killed becomes a reproach, and the thing done blameworthy.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0687

liste.mg: ‘Veloma’ tsy mba adidy, sakafo lany tsy mba andraikitra.
liste.en: ‘May you live’ isn’t blame, a meal eaten isn’t guilt.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0688

liste.mg: Tsorakazo noladinim-bitsika : lofidofiny foana, fa ny tenany be efa marazoka.
liste.en: A twig climbed upon by ants: they bend it little, but its stem is pretty.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0689

liste.mg: Raha tsy manao be fondro, manao be tsiny.
liste.en: Not much blame, yet many faults.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0694

liste.mg: Aza atao famaky manan-tsiny amin’ izay kiakiak’ akoho.
liste.en: Don’t blame the axe when the fowls cry out.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0697

liste.mg: Ny fihavanana tsy azo vidina.
liste.en: Friendship cannot be bought.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0701

liste.mg: My fihavanana hoatra ny siafotsy: raha vao, mikasaosaoka, raha tonta, misy romoromony.
liste.en: Friendship is like a stiff cloth : when new, it rustles (nicely), but when old,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0706

liste.mg: Ny fikavanana toy ny raty: raha henjanina, tapaka; ary raha hetrahina, miboraka.
liste.en: Friendship is like a bad rope: if pulled tightly, it breaks; if pulled lightly,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0707

liste.mg: My fikavanana aze ataonao toy ny siafotsy: intelo asampina, ka _mievotra hiany.
liste.en: Don’t let your friendship be like stiff cloth: though thrice thrown over the shoulder, it still slips off.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0709

liste.mg: Aleo very tsikalakalan-karena toy izay very tsikalakalam-pihavanana.
liste.en: Better lose a little money than a little friendship.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0712

liste.mg: Ny tstkalakalan-karena manam-pahalaniana, fa ny tsikalakalam-pihavanana tsy manam-pahalaniana.
liste.en: The little things and acts which preserve wealth fail, but those which preserve friendship fail not.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0713

liste.mg: Vy voky tsy mahaleo ny tsaroana.
liste.en: A good belly-full doesn’t equal a kind remembrance.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0715

liste.mg: Ny kary aza mitsoka amin' Andriampatsa mahazo, ka indrsndra fa ny havana. .
liste.en: Even the wild-cat that begs of Lord Shrimp gets (something), much more then the friend.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0720

liste.mg: A body tsy afindra reny ; ro tsy afindra vilany.
liste.en: An egg not removed to another mother ; broth not removed to another pot.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0722

liste.mg: Raha revom-potaka, rano no manala ; raha revon-teny, vava no manala; raha revon' alahelo, havana no itarainana.
liste.en: Get into the mud, water will remove it; get into a dispute, the mouth will get you out of it; be overtaken by sorrow, you can appeal to your friends.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0724

liste.mg: Ny fo tsy mandringa, ka raha mandalo aho mitsidika hiany.
liste.en: The heart isn’t lame, so when I pass, I give a look in.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0726

liste.mg: Zavarin’ ny fitia manan-tombo, ka intelo no miarahaba.
liste.en: To be too much in love and give a treble salutation,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0728

liste.mg: Nahoana no ho tia vao ka manary kolokolo P
liste.en: Why do you say you love him, yet begin to desert him ?
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0729

liste.mg: Longo ratsy tsy menatra izay hitsoriaka.
liste.en: A bad friend is not ashamed of slipping away from his friendship.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0732

liste.mg: Mifankatia amin' amalona: ka nony sendra tia, nabolilany.
liste.en: An eel’s friendship : it slips away just when you begin to like it.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0733

liste.mg: Ziy ny varotra no taloha, fa ny fihavanana.
liste.en: It wasn’t business that was first, it was friendship.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0734

liste.mg: A taovy fitia landihazo : ha ny madilana tentenana, ary ny maito tohizana.
liste.en: Love me as you do cotton : add to the thin, and re-join the broken.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0736

liste.mg: Ataovy fihavanam-bava sy tanana: hoa raha marary ny fanana, dia mitsoka ny vava, ary raha marary ny vava, dia misafo ny tanana.
liste.en: Let your friendship be that of the mouth and the hand: if the hand is hurt, the mouth blows it, and if the mouth is hurt, the hand strokes it.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0737

liste.mg: A taovy fitia voampo: mbola lavitra hiany dia ampoizina.
liste.en: Love me as you love the véamfd :+ look out for me while yet far away.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0741

liste.mg: Aza mitaitay, toy ny fitia tsy ho ela.
liste.en: Don’t be in a hurry, like love that won’t last.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0742

liste.mg: Aza manao fitia rano trambo: be fihavy, ka mora lasa.
liste.en: Don’t let your love be like a summer torrent: much at first, but soon gone (or, soon coming and soon going).
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0743

liste.mg: Aza manao fihavana-molotra: tezitra vao mifanatona.
liste.en: Don’t show lip-love and be angry before you come together.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0744

liste.mg: Aza manasakaiza vahiny.
liste.en: Don't make friends of strangers.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0745

liste.mg: Aza manao fitia paraky, ka hatreo am-bava no ho miakatra hiany.
liste.en: Don’t love me as you do tobacco, from the mouth and upwards only.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0746

liste.mg: Aza manao fikavanan’ amboa, ka taolana iray no isarahana.
liste.en: Don't make it a dog’s friendship, to be broken over a bone.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0747

liste.mg: Aza mandalo tanéna misy havana.
liste.en: Don’t pass by a place where there's a friend.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0748

liste.mg: Aza manao fitia mifono avona.
liste.en: Don't let your love be wrapped up in pride.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0749

liste.mg: Aza asesiky ny fitia tanteraka, ka tsy mahalala ny ranonorana ho avy.
liste.en: Don't be so much in love that you can’t tell when the rain is coming.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0750

liste.mg: Aza ely fisian-kavana loatra.
liste.en: Don’t have too few friends.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0752

liste.mg: Aza manao fihavanan-kerana, ka tomany handratra ny sasany.
liste.en: Don’t have the friendship of rushes and try and injure others.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0755

liste.mg: Aza mila lolotr’ amalona aman-kavana.
liste.en: Don’t be on the look-out for a friend’s faults.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0756

liste.mg: Aza manao sakaiza_ manody.
liste.en: Don't prove a false friend.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0757

liste.mg: Aza ny havana no asian-dratsy, fa tsy ho tratran’ ny hafa tsy akory.
liste.en: Don’t do wrong to a friend or relative, for you won't get auother.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0759

liste.mg: Aza manao arahaba mamba : tsy fitia, fa tahotra.
liste.en: Don’t salute a crocodile : it isn’t love. but fear.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0760

liste.mg: Aza sarotra ihamboana toa havan-dratsy.
liste.en: Don’t make yourself difficult to boast of, like a good-for-nothing relative (or friend).
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0761

liste.mg: Havako raha misy patsa; fa raha lany ny patsa, havan-tetezina.
liste.en: He isa near relative while there are shrimps (to be had) ; but when they are done, he is only a distant relative.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0762

liste.mg: Raha voatohina ny aty, marary ny afero.
liste.en: If the liver is poked, the gall-bladder feels it.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0763

liste.mg: Aza manao tsinay homana aty.
liste.en: Don't let the entrails eat the liver.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0764

liste.mg: Aza atao fively amponga ny havana : ka ny tray anabaviny tambitambazana, ary ny tray hosa andahiny hodabodabohana.
liste.en: Don’t serve your friends as you do the ends of a drum: gentle to the one, and rough to the other.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0765

liste.mg: Raha mihavana aminay, aza milela-tanana.
liste.en: If you are friendly with us, don’t lick your hands.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0766

liste.mg: Lafim-bato, vato ; lafin-kazo, hazo ; lafin-kavana, havana.
liste.en: The side of a stone is a stone; the side of wood is wood; the side of a relative (i.e. a distant relative) is a relative.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0769

liste.mg: My maty aza te-ho maro.
liste.en: Even the dead wish to be many.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0774

liste.mg: Ny hazo tokana tsy mba ala.
liste.en: One tree doesn’t make a forest.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0776

liste.mg: Tondro tokana tsy mahazo hao.
liste.en: One finger won't catch a louse.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0777

liste.mg: Olon-drery tsy mba vahoaka.
liste.en: One person doesn’t make a multitude.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0779

liste.mg: Ny be no basy.
liste.en: The many are guns.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0780

liste.mg: Raha mandika ny soa nifanekena aho, tsy satry, fa avilindraha.
liste.en: If I break the good (covenant) agreed on, I do it unwillingly.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0792

liste.mg: Toy ny vatsin' Andrianalabe, ka tsinjarain-kiombonana hiany.
liste.en: Like the woodman's victuals: divided out to be shared in.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0795

liste.mg: Zoy ny famaky mijinja hazo: ka ny ahy momba ny azy.
liste.en: Like the axe Cutting down the tree: mine (i.e. the axe) goes with his (i.e.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0796

liste.mg: Aza manao ahy sy azy.
liste.en: Don’t say ‘mine’ and “his.’
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0798

liste.mg: Ny tray tsy tia mafana, ary ny tray tsy tia mangatsiaka; ka ataovy marimaritra hiraisana.
liste.en: One likes heat, and the other likes cold; pray agree on something and be friends.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0801

liste.mg: Ny feny ierana tsy mba loza.
liste.en: ‘An agreement brings no harm.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0802

liste.mg: Imerina akanga tsy roa volo, fa tray hiany.
liste.en: Imérina is a guinea-fowl, not of two colours, but of one only.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0804

liste.mg: Aza mitangorona toy ny voangory ho ritra.
liste.en: Don't gather together like the edangery (beetle) about to die,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0808

liste.mg: Aza atao mitsoaka an-tonony, hoatra ny tohi-rofian’ ankizy.
liste.en: Don't let it slip out at the joint, like the string tied by a child.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0810

liste.mg: Aza manao toy ny tandindona: miaraka hiany, fa tsy azo ho namana.
liste.en: Don't be like the shadow: a constant companion, but not a comrade (ie. a friend).
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0811

liste.mg: Lambarano voahosotra arina ; tafaray samy ngerona.
liste.en: Dark cloth smeared with soot ; two black things joined together.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0815

liste.mg: Miaraka amin’ ny ferena, ka ny tsara fanahy no maimbo.
liste.en: Being with the diseased, the good will be affected.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0816

liste.mg: Raha tsy marary, aza miray ondana amin’ ny marary.
liste.en: Unless you are sick yourself, don’t share the same pillow with a sick TsOn.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0817

liste.mg: Aza mifonoka ambanin’ ny maimbo.
liste.en: Don’t keep company with any one in bad odour.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0818

liste.mg: Aza manao foly mena tohizan-drofia.
liste.en: Don't join the bad to the good.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0820

liste.mg: Aza mandady miara-komana, hoatra ny mpiandry ratsy.
liste.en: Don't creep to eat together, like a company of bandits,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0822

liste.mg: Aza manao volo-ngita mifandray tendro.
liste.en: Don't unite in wrong doing, like curly hairs on a woolly head.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0823

liste.mg: Aza mantsim-bao miray, hoatra ny rongony.
liste.en: Don’t get bad before you unite, like hemp.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0824

liste.mg: Nahoana no manao kitapo miara-peno.
liste.en: Why do you all fill one bag ?
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0825

liste.mg: Ny fahatelo be ho tsy mampanana.
liste.en: An enemy helps not to fortune.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0826

liste.mg: Mpandrava efa, toa voalavo.
liste.en: A destroyer of finished work, like a rat.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0827

liste.mg: Aza manetry montotra.
liste.en: Don’t cast down in ‘anger.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0828

liste.mg: Aza manao rano manindao namana.
liste.en: Don't be like a river and sweep your friends downwards.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0829

liste.mg: Lolompon-kovalahy, tsy miseho tsy ratsy tany.
liste.en: The malice of a Hova; it doesn’t show itself till troublous times,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0830

liste.mg: Aza milavoa tst-ary: mangata-pary tray vany ka mitady izay ‘sy hiraisana.
liste.en: ‘Don’t want what you can’t get: ask for a joint of sugar-cane to find a means of separation.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0834

liste.mg: Tstkovoka sy fandiorano: volo no ivatsana, fa ny fomba samy ‘manana ny azy.
liste.en: The water-beetle and the water-boatman : of one colour, but of diverse kinds.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0838

liste.mg: Tstboboka sy toho: rano no traisana, fa ny tarehy samy hafa.
liste.en: ‘A tadpole and a fish: they live in the same water, but have a different appearance,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0839

liste.mg: Zafondro natifi-baratra , ka tafahaona samy loza.
liste.en: A cannon that shot a thunderbolt, so one dreadful thing met another.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0841

liste.mg: Tsy miady, sahala ; ka hiady, hisy resy.
liste.en: Tf you don’t fight, you are my equal; if you do fight, one will be conquered.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0847

liste.mg: Ady tsy ahi-mahatratra.
liste.en: A dispute not guarded against reaches yourself.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0850

liste.mg: Raha tsy te-hiady aza hianao, tsy maintsy miady raha miaraka amin’ Imahaly.
liste.en: Though you don’t want to fight, you must fight if you go with Imahaly.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0852

liste.mg: Zoy ny aretin’ omby ny teny, ka izay mirehodrehoka no hifindrany.
liste.en: A quarrel is like a cattle disease, and it shifts to those who come into contact with it.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0853

liste.mg: A fody tsy miady amim-bato.
liste.en: An egg does'nt fight with a stone.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0857

liste.mg: Ady misy hena, ka ny mamoy no liana.
liste.en: A quarrel about meat, the one who gives it up is hungry.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0859

liste.mg: Borera sy voantay mitolona, loha no amantarana azy.
liste.en: ‘A brown beetle and a scavenger beetle struggling, you can only tell them by their heads.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0860

liste.mg: My hofak’ ondry no soa misavily, fa ny teny tsy mba soa misavily.
liste.en: A sheep's tail is good to swing, but a dispute isn't good to swing.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0861

liste.mg: Adin’ akoholahy vorom-bato: ny mahery disadisaka, ary ny resy torotoro.
liste.en: A fight of game-cocks: the conqueror is bruised, and the conquered is torn to pieces.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0862

liste.mg: Aza mandeha singany toy ny Riraron’ Ibenahy.
liste.en: Don't go alone like Ibénahy’s shoe.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0865

liste.mg: Misalasala, hoatra ny adin-ondrilahy: akorain-tsy mifampianja ; avela hiany, mifamaky loha.
liste.en: Doubtful, like a ram-fight: urged on, they don't toss one another up;
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0867

liste.mg: Mitsana-menimenina, hoatra ny vary sosoa voatondraka, na ny voangory mipaika.
liste.en: To cease murmuring, like boiling rice that has run over, or a voangory (beetle) that has knocked itself.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0868

liste.mg: Tsy mba ny akanga hanidina aho, fa ny vorombazaha entina amin’ ny tendany.
liste.en: I am not a guinea-fowl to fly away, but a duck to be carried by the throat.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0869

liste.mg: Vy firaka no tsy mba vola ny lemim-panahiny.
liste.en: Lead is not silver because of its softness.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0872

liste.mg: Aza manositosika ny tsy manombika.
liste.en: Don’t push these who don't cut pieces off the mat.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0878

liste.mg: Fo tezitra tsy ananan-drariny.
liste.en: ‘An angry heart is not possessed of right.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0879

liste.mg: Ny latsaka ao am-po tsy hamelona, ha ny an-tendro-molotra no lelajina.
liste.en: What you have eaten already is enough to kill you, yet you lick what comes to your lips again (ie. you are evidently wishing for more).
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0891

liste.mg: Varatra tsy indroa miriatra.
liste.en: A thunderbolt doesn’t strike twice,
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0894

liste.mg: Aza manao ady an-tsanga.
liste.en: ‘Don't be a contentious wrangler.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0901

liste.mg: Tsy mety raha an-dafin-drano, ka tsy holakanina, na an-dafintsaha, ka tsy hotoharana.
liste.en: Don't refuse to canoe me over when on the other side of the water, or to meet me when on the other side of the field.
liste.ref: Houlder, « Ohabolana », The Antananarivo Annual — ohab_0903
